a.d: The subject performs the action directly on their own body or object.
ex: 아이가 식탁에 앉아 스스로 밥을 **먹었어요**. / The child sat at the table and ate rice by themselves.

b.d: The subject causes another person or creature to perform the action or provides direct assistance.
ex: 어머니가 식탁에서 아이에게 따뜻한 밥을 **먹였어요**. / The mother fed warm rice to the child at the table.

im-c57-01.tip: Common causative pairs: 먹다/먹이다, 입다/입히다, 앉다/앉히다, 읽다/읽히다, 남다/남기다.

im-c57-01.q: Fix the sentence where an active verb was used instead of the causative verb for dressing a child.

answers: 추운 겨울날 어머니가 어린아이에게 두꺼운 외투를 입혔어요.
추운 겨울날 어머니가 어린아이에게 두꺼운 외투를 입혔어요
추운 겨울날 어머니가 어린아이에게 두꺼운 외투를 입히셨어요.
추운 겨울날 어머니가 어린아이에게 두꺼운 외투를 입히셨어요
im-c57-01.hint: Use causative 입히다 (to dress someone): 입혔어요.
im-c57-01.why: Mother dresses the child, requiring the causative verb 입히다 rather than base 입다.

im-c57-01.say: 어머니가 식탁에서 어린아이에게 따뜻한 죽을 먹였어요
answers: 어머니가 식탁에서 어린아이에게 따뜻한 죽을 먹였어요
어머니가 식탁에서 어린아이에게 따뜻한 죽을 먹였어요.
im-c57-01.hint: Mother fed warm porridge to the young child at the dining table.
im-c57-01.why: Causative past tense of 먹다: 먹였어요.

im-c57-01.q: Write a sentence stating that you dressed your sibling in a warm coat before going out, using 코트를 and 입혔어요.
im-c57-01.sample: 외출하기 전에 동생에게 따뜻한 겨울 코트를 입혔어요.
im-c57-01.why: Using causative 입히다 to express dressing another person.

base.en: I dressed the child in clothes.

steps.en: In cold weather, I warmly dressed the child in thick winter clothes.

tokens: 스스로 감기 걸리지 않게 따뜻하게 입혔어요.
steps.en: In freezing harsh cold weather, I warmly dressed the child in thick winter clothes with a hood so they wouldn’t catch cold.

ko: 아침마다 어머니는 어린 동생에게 숟가락으로 따뜻한 밥을 먹이신다.
밥을 다 먹인 뒤에는 따뜻한 외투를 입히고 가방을 메어 주신다.
현관문 앞 의자에 동생을 앉히고 신발까지 신겨 주며 배웅하신다.
en: Every morning mother feeds warm rice to my young sibling with a spoon.
After feeding all the rice, she puts on a warm coat and carries the backpack.
Seating my sibling on the chair in front of the doorway, she even puts on shoes and sees them off.

im-c57-01.q: What everyday morning acts does mother perform for the young sibling?
options: Feeds meals, dresses in coats, and seats them to put on shoes
Orders the sibling to cook breakfast alone
Leaves the house without saying goodbye
im-c57-01.why: The text describes feeding (먹이다), dressing (입히다), and seating (앉히다).

im-c57-01.q: Which causative verb means to help or make someone sit down?
im-c57-01.why: 앉히다 is the causative form of 앉다 (to sit).

items: I can differentiate base verbs from causative verbs with -이/히/리/기-.
I can accurately describe actions performed to aid children, family, or guests.

a.d: Describes the subject’s own action or time state.
ex: 회의 시간이 예정보다 한 시간 **늦었어요**. / The meeting time was an hour late compared to schedule.

b.d: Changes or adjusts parameters, schedules, or states by human intervention.
ex: 일정이 겹쳐서 회의 시간을 한 시간 **늦췄어요**. / Due to overlapping schedules, we postponed the meeting by one hour.

im-c57-02.tip: Key special causative verbs: 타다 → 태우다 (give a ride), 자다 → 재우다 (put to sleep), 늦다 → 늦추다 (delay/postpone), 낮다 → 낮추다 (lower).

im-c57-02.q: Fix the sentence where an intransitive verb was mistakenly used instead of the causative verb for delaying schedule.
im-c57-02.wrong: 폭설 때문에 기차 출발 시각을 삼십 분 늦었어요.
answers: 폭설 때문에 기차 출발 시각을 삼십 분 늦췄어요.
폭설 때문에 기차 출발 시각을 삼십 분 늦췄어요
폭설 때문에 기차 출발 시각을 삼십 분 늦추었습니다.
폭설 때문에 기차 출발 시각을 삼십 분 늦추었습니다
im-c57-02.hint: Use the causative verb 늦추다 (to postpone/delay): 늦췄어요.
im-c57-02.why: When postponing an object (출발 시각을), use the causative verb 늦추다.

items.ex: 품에 안고 자장가를 부르며 아기를 재웠다.
아침 일곱 시에 알람 소리로 깨웠어요.
출발 시간을 한 시간 뒤로 늦췄습니다.

im-c57-02.say: 집에 가는 방향이 같으니 제 차로 역까지 태워 드릴게요
answers: 집에 가는 방향이 같으니 제 차로 역까지 태워 드릴게요
집에 가는 방향이 같으니 제 차로 역까지 태워 드릴게요.
im-c57-02.hint: Since our directions heading home are the same, I will give you a ride to the station in my car.
im-c57-02.why: Causative carpool phrase 태우다: 태워 드릴게요.

im-c57-02.q: Write a sentence offering a coworker a ride home in your car, using 친구를 and 태워.
im-c57-02.sample: 퇴근하는 길에 지하철역까지 친구를 차에 태워 주었어요.
im-c57-02.why: Using causative 태워 주다 to express giving someone a ride.

base.en: I put the baby to sleep.

steps.en: Singing a lullaby, I cozily put the whimpering baby to sleep.

tokens: 방 안의 조명을 어둡게 낮추고 자장가를 부르며
steps.en: Dimming the room lights and singing a lullaby, I carefully laid the whimpering baby in my arms onto the bed and cozily put them to sleep.

ko: 갑작스러운 폭설로 비행기 출발 시간이 두 시간 뒤로 늦춰졌다.
공항으로 향하던 길에 발이 묶인 동료를 차에 태워 함께 공항으로 이동했다.
탑승 전까지 라운지 음악 소리를 낮추고 차분하게 휴식을 취했다.
en: Due to sudden heavy snow, the flight departure time was postponed by two hours.
On the way heading to the airport, I gave a ride in my car to a colleague who was stranded and moved to the airport together.
Until boarding, we lowered the lounge music volume and took a calm rest.

im-c57-02.q: Why was the flight departure postponed in the text?
options: Because the airport runway was under construction
im-c57-02.why: The text opens: 갑작스러운 폭설로 비행기 출발 시간이 두 시간 뒤로 늦춰졌다.

im-c57-02.q: Which verb in the story means giving someone a ride in a vehicle?
im-c57-02.why: 태우다 means to let someone ride or give someone a ride in a vehicle.

items: I can use special causative verbs with -우/구/추- like 태우다 and 늦추다.
I can offer practical courtesies such as car rides and adjusting volumes or schedules.

im-c57-03.h: 직접 사동 (단어 사동) vs 간접 사동 (-게 하다)

a.d: The subject physically performs the action directly onto the target object or person.
ex: 어머니가 아기에게 직접 옷을 **입혔어요**. / Mother directly dressed the baby in clothes by hand.

b.d: The subject instructs, permits, or creates an environment for the target to act autonomously.
ex: 선생님은 학생들이 스스로 교복을 **입게 했어요**. / The teacher had the students wear uniforms autonomously.

im-c57-03.tip: -게 하다 can attach to virtually all verbs and adjectives, conveying indirect causation, permission, or causing emotions (기쁘게 하다, 슬프게 하다).

im-c57-03.q: Fix the sentence where an apology for making someone wait was awkwardly phrased.
im-c57-03.wrong: 약속 시간에 늦어서 친구를 30분이나 기다리도록 봤어요.
answers: 약속 시간에 늦어서 친구를 30분이나 기다리게 했어요.
약속 시간에 늦어서 친구를 30분이나 기다리게 했어요
약속 시간에 늦어서 친구를 30분이나 기다리게 하였습니다.
약속 시간에 늦어서 친구를 30분이나 기다리게 하였습니다
im-c57-03.hint: Use indirect causative -게 하다: 기다리게 했어요.
im-c57-03.why: The common idiom for causing someone to wait is 기다리게 하다.

items.ex: 피곤한 직원들을 일찍 퇴근하여 쉬게 했다.
모든 팀원이 회의에 적극적으로 참여하게 했다.

im-c57-03.say: 연락이 늦어져서 오랜 시간 걱정하게 해 드려 정말 죄송합니다
answers: 연락이 늦어져서 오랜 시간 걱정하게 해 드려 정말 죄송합니다
연락이 늦어져서 오랜 시간 걱정하게 해 드려 정말 죄송합니다.
im-c57-03.hint: I am truly sorry for making you worry for a long time due to delayed contact.
im-c57-03.why: Courteous honorific causative apology: 걱정하게 해 드려.

im-c57-03.q: Write a sentence explaining that the teacher had students ask questions freely in class, using 학생들이 and 질문하게.
im-c57-03.sample: 선생님은 수업 시간에 학생들이 자유롭게 질문하게 하셨어요.
im-c57-03.why: Using indirect causative -게 하다 to show guiding students to ask questions.

steps.en: Because of traffic congestion, I made my friend wait long at the meeting place.

tokens: 추운 날씨 속 약속 장소에서 친구를
삼십 분이나 미안하게 오래 기다리게 했어요.
steps.en: Due to sudden rush-hour traffic jams, I apologetically made my friend wait long for thirty minutes at the meetup spot in cold weather.

ko: 선생님은 수업 시간에 일방적으로 설명하기보다 학생들이 자유롭게 토론하게 하셨다.
주말에는 과도한 숙제를 내주지 않고 학생들이 충분히 쉬게 배려하셨다.
이러한 교육 방식은 학생들로 하여금 스스로 질문하고 답을 찾게 만들었다.
en: Rather than explaining unilaterally during class, the teacher had the students discuss freely.
On weekends, she took care to let students rest sufficiently without assigning excessive homework.
This teaching method led students to question and find answers on their own.

im-c57-03.q: How did the teacher manage class activities?
options: Encouraged students to discuss freely instead of lecturing unilaterally
Forced students to memorize entire textbooks silently
im-c57-03.why: The first line highlights: 학생들이 자유롭게 토론하게 하셨다.

im-c57-03.q: What role does -게 하다 play in the sentence 학생들이 충분히 쉬게 배려하셨다?
options: Permitting or fostering conditions for students to rest autonomously
im-c57-03.why: -게 하다 conveys facilitating or permitting the action to take place.

items: I can differentiate direct action suffixes from indirect permission/causation (-게 하다).
I can make respectful apologies acknowledging the listener’s time or concern.

im-c57-04.h: 일방적 상황 설명 vs 사동을 활용한 정중한 배려

a.d: Merely mentions external conditions without addressing the other party’s inconvenience.
ex: 길이 막혀서 약속에 늦었어요. / Traffic was jammed, so I arrived late.

b.d: Directly acknowledges the impact on the other party, expressing heartfelt empathy.
ex: 차가 많이 막혀서 오래 **기다리게 해 드렸지요?** 죄송해요. / Traffic was heavy so I made you wait long, didn’t I? I am sorry.

im-c57-04.tip: In everyday Korean, using causative verbs like 기다리게 하다, 걱정하게 하다, and 태워 주다 creates warmth and builds strong interpersonal bonds.

im-c57-04.q: Fix the awkward sentence when offering an umbrella to someone in heavy rain.

answers: 비가 오니까 제 우산을 같이 씌워 드릴게요.
비가 오니까 제 우산을 같이 씌워 드릴게요
비가 오니까 제 우산을 씌워 드릴게요.
비가 오니까 제 우산을 씌워 드릴게요
im-c57-04.hint: Use the causative verb 씌워 주다/드리다: 씌워 드릴게요.
im-c57-04.why: Covering someone with an umbrella uses the causative verb 씌우다 (씌워 드리다).

items.ex: 비가 오니 집 앞까지 태워다 줄게요.

약속 시간에 늦어서 오래 기다리게 해 드려 정말 죄송합니다.
im-c57-04.hint: I am truly sorry for arriving late to our appointment and making you wait long.
im-c57-04.why: Polite honorific causative apology: 기다리게 해 드려.

im-c57-04.q: Write a warm sentence offering to share your umbrella with someone walking to the station, using 우산을 and 씌워.
im-c57-04.sample: 비가 많이 내리니 지하철역까지 제 우산을 씌워 드릴게요.

base.en: I will give you a ride home.

steps.en: Since our directions are the same, I will comfortably give you a ride home in front of the subway station.

tokens: 비 오는 날 지하철역 앞 집까지
제 차로 안전하고 편하게 태워다 드릴게요.
steps.en: Since our commute directions match, I will safely and comfortably give you a ride in my car home in front of the subway station on this rainy day.

ko: 퇴근 무렵 갑자기 소나기가 쏟아져 우산이 없는 직장 동료들이 곤란해했다.
마침 차를 가지고 출근했던 김 대리가 같은 방향인 동료들을 역까지 태워 주었다.
동료들은 바쁜 퇴근길에 귀한 시간을 내어 주어 정말 고맙다며 인사를 전했다.
en: Around clock-out time, a sudden shower poured down and coworkers without umbrellas were troubled.
Deputy Kim, who happened to commute by car, gave colleagues heading in the same direction a ride to the station.
Coworkers thanked him sincerely for sparing valuable time on a busy commute home.

im-c57-04.q: What thoughtful deed did Deputy Kim offer coworkers on a rainy evening?
options: Gave coworkers a ride to the subway station in his car
Charged colleagues money for disposable plastic umbrellas
Refused to talk and left the parking lot alone
im-c57-04.why: The text highlights: 같은 방향인 동료들을 역까지 태워 주었다.

im-c57-04.q: Which phrase is the natural everyday causative expression for giving someone a ride?
im-c57-04.why: 태워 주다 is the standard Korean phrase for giving someone a ride in a car.

items: I can extend kind gestures like carpools or sharing umbrellas using polite causative phrasing.
I can formulate sincere apologies that empathetically recognize others’ patience.
